verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Chat, part of the Agent Platform, lets users talk to the product in natural language. The docs say it works in the GitLab UI, IDEs and the Duo CLI, finds merge requests from plain-language requests without IDs or URLs, has context on issues, MRs, commits and pipelines, and can propose and implement solutions with human-in-the-loop approvals. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice, and evidence that it covers product operations beyond code and project work (e.g. admin or settings changes).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: GitLab Duo Chat is available in: The GitLab UI. A variety of IDEs. The GitLab Duo CLI.
Chat has access to your project, including issues, merge requests, commits, and CI/CD pipelines, and Chat maintains context across conversations.
It can provide advice, but it can also propose and implement solutions.
agentic Chat can search for these resources without requiring you to specify exact IDs or URLs.
Human in the loop approvals for chat-based GitLab Duo Agent Platform sessions
